known_limitations: The voice level works only on downloaded songs once they are separated whole, which happens while the phone charges.
Separated songs play about 0.09 s later than they otherwise would, at every voice level, so that moving the slider never makes the sound jump.
The high-quality model is about ten times slower than the quick one; in automatic mode it only runs while the phone charges.
Being a beta tag, the in-app updater does not offer it to users of a stable version; it is offered on the website and the releases page.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
